recipes.name: Easy Chunky Guacamole
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the avocados, lime juice, garlic, and spices. Mash the avocados, leaving some chunks if a textured consistency is preferred.
Gently stir in the onion, tomato, and chives*. Garnish and serve with tortilla chips or fresh veggies, or enjoy in sandwiches or wraps!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use pure ground chili powder made from dried chili peppers - not to be confused with the chili powder spice blend commonly found in the US, which often includes cumin, garlic powder, and other seasonings. For the intended heat and flavour, be sure to use pure chili powder. * If desired, the tomato seeds can be removed before adding to preserve the guacamole's vibrant colour.

Storage To retain its bright colour, this is best to enjoy immediately, or at least on the same day it's made. Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 day, but do note it will turn brown.
